expected.shortDescription: The acclaimed community reimagining of 2008–2009 era TF2 with 4-team and VIP modes.
expected.description: Team Fortress 2 Classic (TF2C) is a standalone Source SDK mod that reimagines TF2's golden era with classic gameplay, restored beta weapons, 4-team battles (RED, BLU, GRN, YLW), and the Civilian VIP escort mode.

external_installer.instructions: Download the TF2 Classic launcher or standalone archive and extract to sourcemods/tf2classic.

set.shortDescription: A fan-made reimagining of 2008–2009 era TF2 with four-team and VIP modes, free on Steam. Requires Team Fortress 2.
set.description: Team Fortress 2 Classified, formerly Team Fortress 2 Classic, is a free fan-made game on Steam that reimagines TF2's early years with restored weapons, four-team battles (RED, BLU, GRN, YLW) and the Civilian VIP escort mode. It requires Team Fortress 2 to be installed.
set.license: Free to play, fan project (requires Team Fortress 2)

requirements.min: Windows 10 64-bit; 2 GB RAM; DirectX 9.0c; 7 GB storage. Linux: Debian 13 / glibc 2.39+; 2 GB RAM; 8 GB storage
requirements.recommended: Windows 11 64-bit; 4 GB RAM; DirectX 9.0c; 8 GB storage. Linux: 4 GB RAM; 8 GB storage; Vulkan recommended
requirements.notes: Requires Team Fortress 2 (Steam app 440) to be installed.
